title: Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask
subtitle: A gentleman behind a mask
summary: Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask is Level-5's puzzle adventure set in Monte d'Or, a city troubled by the apparently supernatural performances of a masked gentleman. Hershel Layton arrives with Luke and Emmy after receiving a request from an old friend. The investigation also returns to his youth, connecting the present mystery with an earlier expedition. Released alongside the Nintendo 3DS in Japan, it introduces three-dimensional characters and surroundings while retaining the conversations, hidden puzzles and animated storytelling that give the professor's journeys their familiar rhythm.
body: Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask is Level-5's puzzle adventure set in Monte d'Or, a city troubled by the apparently supernatural performances of a masked gentleman. Hershel Layton arrives with Luke and Emmy after receiving a request from an old friend. The investigation also returns to his youth, connecting the present mystery with an earlier expedition. Released alongside the Nintendo 3DS in Japan, it introduces three-dimensional characters and surroundings while retaining the conversations, hidden puzzles and animated storytelling that give the professor's journeys their familiar rhythm.

The touchscreen now moves a magnifying glass across the scene on the upper display. A change in its appearance identifies something worth examining, whether a person, a hidden coin or another part of the location. Players can zoom into selected areas to inspect them more closely. Puzzles still use the touchscreen, with hints available in exchange for collected coins. Solving a puzzle earns Picarats, with mistakes reducing the reward. The revised interface lets the new three-dimensional locations remain visible while the player's hand directs the investigation below.

Sections following the young Layton place him inside underground ruins, where moving boulders and avoiding mummies turn exploration into a more continuous spatial puzzle. Other activities include arranging a shop's shelves, guiding a toy robot and teaching a rabbit actions for a performance. These smaller systems extend through puzzles found along the main journey. They give the notebook purposes beyond storing clues, while the alternating periods reveal a protagonist who already had friends, doubts and unfinished experiences before becoming the gentleman Luke knows.
story_headings: A magnifying glass crosses two screens
